killedBy: driver: the developer single-tick step (issue #253) RESUMING after steps neither repeats them nor catches up the paused time
why: Each step leaves 20 ms of real time owed to the frame clock, so the first frame after Resume repays the steps as extra ticks: the match jumps ahead by roughly one tick per step taken. Issue #253's criterion is that resuming after a step neither repeats nor catches up paused time.
